items.title: Unit tests pass
items.description: Verify isolated Seed-critical behavior through the repository test suite.
items.method: Run npm test from the repository root as the shared test producer.
evidence_required: Exact npm test command and exit status.
Complete passing summary or failing diagnostics from all test files.
Confirmation that fixture repositories and homes were disposable and cleaned.
items.evidence: @verifications.unit-tests re-reviewed after the intentional GitHub license genome catalog expansion. Its stored proof commands pass against the current revision; changed evidence files test/genomes.test.js remain consistent with this item and active global policies.

items.title: Repository README is accurate and safely executable
items.description: Verify @repo-readme contains the actual project entrypoint information, inventory every shell command, and use @seed-evidence-scripts to exercise safe real CLI paths only in disposable repository and user-home locations.
items.method: Reuse npm test as the shared test producer, then run node seed/scripts/verify-readme.js from the repository root. The verifier classifies every README shell command, rejects unknown command forms, and executes representative project, genome, verification, named-Seed, and skill-installation paths under a temporary repository, HOME, CODEX_HOME, and CLAUDE_HOME that it removes in a finally block. Network/global-install, placeholder, interactive pager, and terminal evidence-transition examples are inspected but not executed.
evidence_required: Exact npm test and README verifier commands with exit statuses.
Confirmation that repository files and real user skill homes were unchanged.
items.evidence: @verifications.repo-readme re-reviewed under the injection authorization guard; strict executable proof passed: npm test; node seed/scripts/verify-readme.js.

addresses.fingerprint: {"description":"Injection is a speed-focused SDD mode used only when the operator directly requests \"SDD injection\". The agent changes the Seed first, implements the resulting address delta, evaluates only new or modified addresses and affected evidence, then uses verify inject with the exact operator-requested-sdd-injection authorization acknowledgement to record truthful per-command pass or fail attestations without the CLI executing those commands. Missing or incorrect authorization fails before any state transition. Injected records retain the authorization, owner, timestamp, product revision, evidence-file hashes, Seed-address fingerprints, and conspicuous provenance in status, audit, and report output. They may satisfy and sync the session, while a later verify check executes their command strings and replaces the attestations with ordinary executable results. Injection is never selected implicitly and does not weaken missing-file, changed-address, failure, or unsatisfied-session handling.","id":"injection-run"}
